profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at American Honda Motor Company, Inc.
profile.summary:
•	Over 8+ years of experience in Designing, Installing and Maintaining SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013, SharePoint Online Office 365.
•	Experience in installing and configuring the windows server 2008, windows server 2012, Active Directory and SQL server 2008.
•	Experienced in using the SharePoint Business Connectivity Service to bring the external data into SharePoint through On-Prem configuration.
•	Configured User Profile Service and Search Service in SharePoint environment.
•	Experienced in working with the Application Pools, Active Directory and Managed Metadata Services.
•	Efficiently used the third party tools like Nintex, Kwizcom and DocAve in different projects. 
•	Configured the InfoPath Forms Services to make the users to fill out the forms in a web browser.
•	Expertise in installing the Axceler Control Point to manage the Site User permissions report on SharePoint.
•	Upgraded and Migrated the SharePoint 2010 to the SharePoint 2013 and SharePoint Online Office 365 as well.
•	Experienced in working as an On-call Support person to resolve the issues raised. 
•	Experience in configuring the SharePoint for Business Intelligence.     
•	Experience in designing the InfoPath forms, workflows, Lists.
•	Efficient experience with the PowerShell scripting for automating tasks.
•	Proficient in dealing with the web content management, record management and content deployment.
•	Experience in creating custom sites, pages, list and libraries.
•	Experienced upgrading SharePoint content though out of box functionality Inplace Upgrade.
•	Managed Site permissions for lists, libraries, pages and sites within the site collection.
•	Experience in troubleshooting the workflows using the SharePoint Designer and Nintex workflows.
•	Experienced in working with the Web Part Pages service which is used to send and retrieve information from web services.
•	Expertise in implementing the Sandbox solutions.
•	Experience in implementing SharePoint within the Office 365 environment.

positions.description: Microsoft SharePoint Migration 2010 on Prem to 2016 on Prem Credit Suisse Bank

positions.title: Senior System Analyst
positions.description:
* Provide technical systems support to team members and partners across the enterprise for SharePoint Services.

* Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem resolution by providing technical support for routine to complex issues reported to the Enterprise SharePoint Service Desk Team.

* Use diagnostic and other tools to maintain, troubleshoot and restore service according to service level agreement criteria.

* Possess technical competency in troubleshoot interdependent systems from the client side, related to SharePoint (network, active directory, software and browser) through the use of desktop troubleshooting tools (Fiddler, Netmon, IE, Developer Tools, etc.).

* Lead/facilitate high severity application production issues through resolution.

* Responsible for communication of production issues accurately and timely.

* Maintain, form and perform quality checks of the automated systems.

* Identify technical support gaps in the current technology process and recommend changes and usability to assure SLAs can be supported.

* Act as a liaison between customer’s/business partners and technical organization by assisting in the planning or analysis of basic business problems to be solved with automated solutions and systems.

* Provide technical assistance and support in identifying and evaluating automated systems and related procedures that are cost effective and meet business requirements.

* Work with user groups to provide training, resolve questions, assess user needs and make necessary changes to the services.

* Assist in developing guidelines for use of services for both support teams and team member customers.

* Actively participate in knowledge base, FAQs, and social media to provide subject matter expertise about the services and systems.

* Provide guidance to less experienced analysts.

positions.description:

    Experience configuring SharePoint for internal and external access (DMZ, Firewall, load balancers) Security certificates Effective verbal and written communication skills

    Strong consulting skills, demonstrated ability to work with internal customers
    Strong troubleshooting and analysis skills Strong mentor ship skills

positions.title: Sharepoint Administrator
positions.description:
•	Designed and Architected the migration of SharePoint from SharePoint 2010 to SharePoint Online Office 365.
•	Installed and Configured a SharePoint 2013 Farm.
•	Installed and Configured DOCAVE on SharePoint 2013 On-Perm environment.
•	Installed, Designed and provided Development support for the Microsoft SharePoint 2010 and Microsoft SharePoint 2013 environments.
•	Involved in the configuration of SharePoint for the Business Intelligence.
•	Installed and Configured Nintex workflow 2013 and Nintex Forms 2013.
•	Involved in the Upgrades and migrations of SharePoint from WSS 3.0 and Moss 2007 to SharePoint 2010.
•	Implemented and maintained intranet portal, databases and client SharePoint sites.
•	Managed sites and site collection features, their functionality and user permissions.
•	Executed the PowerShell scripts for automating the tasks and reporting.
•	Configured the Search application service as well as the User Profile Service.
•	Created the custom forms using the InfoPath.
•	Troubleshot the list and site level workflows using the SharePoint Designer and Nintex Workflows.
•	Configured, maintained and assigned permission levels for all users of SharePoint site collections.
•	Performed training sessions On-Prem to adapt to the new SharePoint 2013 sites.
•	Provided ticket resolution and end user support.

Environment: SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013, SharePoint Designer, Nintex, SQL Server 2008, IIS 6.0/7.0

positions.title: Sharepoint Administrator
positions.description:
•	Designed and upgraded the available Microsoft SharePoint 2010 to the Microsoft SharePoint 2013.
•	Installed and maintained the Dev environment for the SharePoint 2013.
•	Performed the Site migration batches to the Site owners as well as Business units.
•	Involved in supporting 2 SharePoint Farms functioning on SharePoint 2010.
•	Performed POC efforts to upgrade a batch of site collections to the new form for SharePoint 2013.
•	Installed Exceled Control Point to manage Site User Permission reports on SharePoint.	
•	Customized the SharePoint solutions using the web technologies HTML, CSS, JAVASCRIPT, JQUERY and XML.
•	Provided Tier 3 support to ensure the availability and reliability of various farms.
•	Applied various updates and patches to the SharePoint 2007, SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013 with minimum amount of patching time.
•	Provided and Monitored health check statuses frequently of the environments.
•	Managed and deployed web applications, site collections and custom builds.
